# canary proposals --help · COLUMNS=80 · colour off
canary proposals — Review proposals to close or reduce positions

Usage: canary proposals <action> [flags]

Actions
  status            Read proposal monitoring and trading status
  refresh           Refresh protection proposals without submitting orders
  list              Read current protection proposals
  preview           Check a proposal without submitting it
  prepare           Prepare a private proposal handoff; no submission
  prepared-status   Read a preparation receipt using its private reference
  prepare-bundle    Prepare a private bundle handoff; no submission
  submit-bundle     Submit an approved bundle through the trading gates
  bundle-status     Read a bundle receipt using its private reference
  submit            Submit an approved proposal through the trading gates
  reduce            Preview a reduction; --submit requests a gated order
  request-stop      Draft a protective stop without placing it
  ignore            Record that a proposal should be ignored
  veto              Stop a pending pre-authorised submission; human only
  queue             Prepare, arm, cancel or read an owner-approved order queue

Run canary proposals <action> --help for syntax and flags.
